description: This file defines the StreamProgress class, a helper class that manages a map of SparkDataStream sources to their respective Offsets, and provides methods to convert between different offset representations used in Spark Structured Streaming.

classes.name: StreamProgress
classes.description: A helper class that acts like a Map[Source, Offset], providing methods to convert between different offset formats and manage source-offset mappings.

methods.name: toOffsets
methods.description: Converts StreamProgress to the appropriate OffsetSeq format based on metadata version.

methods.name: toOffsetSeq
methods.description: Converts the source list and metadata into an OffsetSeq object.

methods.name: toOffsetMap
methods.description: Converts the internal map to an OffsetMap, reversing the source-to-ID mapping.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the baseMap.

methods.name: updated
methods.description: Returns a new Map with the specified source updated with a new offset.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the offset for a given source, if present.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the source-offset pairs.

methods.name: removed
methods.description: Returns a new Map with the specified source removed.
Returns a new StreamProgress with additional source-offset pairs added.
